title: Welcome to the Outcast's Restaurant!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Dennis, a popular member of the Silverwing Battalion, is expelled out of spite by the party leader and opens a restaurant for adventurers with Atelier, a young girl also exiled from her home (Kaiten Books blurb). The ANN anime review adds that Atelier was a slave and that Dennis gathers other outcasts, including Henrietta, who is the victim of a sexual assault. Manga adaptation of a light novel, 10 volumes ongoing (MU).
life_message: People cast out by the powerful can build a found family and a good life through honest work and hospitality.

content.note: Dungeon fights, a villain 'cruel towards small animals and people' (ANN anime); MU Revenge, Abuse of Power.

folkways.japan: The 'expelled from the party' setup is a common Japanese web-novel trope; group exclusion and finding a new place to belong reflect a concern with group membership.

delivery.evidence: ANN (anime) calls the dark material 'edgelordery' and the friendship climax empty; no comment on preachiness (to verify).
delivery.note: The cruel former party leader appears to be a sadistic villain rather than the voice of a worldview.

winners_losers: Dennis and the outcasts he takes in win sympathy; the spiteful, cruel party leadership and slavers are the losers.
